sloka: तदस्मिन् कार्यनिर्योगे वीरैवं दुरतिक्रमे ।किं पश्यसि समाधानं ब्रूहि कार्यविदां वर ।। ५.६८.१० ।।।।
transliteration: tadasmin kāryaniryoge vīraivaṁ duratikrame ।kiṁ paśyasi samādhānaṁ brūhi kāryavidāṁ vara ।। 5.68.10 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O heroic Hanuman you know how to succeed. But I wish to know what expedient you have to accomplish which is difficult by all means. O foremost vanara, please tell me .
